legal_units.title: Income Tax Department
legal_units.text: Where a non-resident Indian in any tax year,—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XIII DETERMINATION OF TAX IN SPECIAL CASES Chapter XIII, Division E Special provisions relating to non-residents and foreign companies Section 217 Income Tax Department Section 217(1): Where a non-resident Indian in any tax year,—
legal_units.chapter_title: DETERMINATION OF TAX IN SPECIAL CASES
legal_units.division_title: Special provisions relating to non-residents and foreign companies

legal_units.title: Income Tax Department
legal_units.text: becomes assessable as a resident in India in respect of total income in a subsequent year; and
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XIII DETERMINATION OF TAX IN SPECIAL CASES Chapter XIII, Division E Special provisions relating to non-residents and foreign companies Section 217 Income Tax Department Section 217(1): Where a non-resident Indian in any tax year,— Section 217(1)(a): becomes assessable as a resident in India in respect of total income in a subsequent year; and
legal_units.chapter_title: DETERMINATION OF TAX IN SPECIAL CASES
legal_units.division_title: Special provisions relating to non-residents and foreign companies

legal_units.title: Income Tax Department
legal_units.text: furnishes a declaration in writing to the Assessing Officer along with his return of income under section 263 for the tax year for which he is so assessable, to the effect that provisions of sections 212 to 216 shall continue to apply to him in relation to the investment income derived from any foreign exchange asset referred to in section 212(e) other than shares in an Indian company, then the provisions of sections 212 to 216 shall continue to apply in relation to such income for that tax year and every subsequent tax year until the transfer or conversion (otherwise than by transfer) of such assets into money.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XIII DETERMINATION OF TAX IN SPECIAL CASES Chapter XIII, Division E Special provisions relating to non-residents and foreign companies Section 217 Income Tax Department Section 217(1): Where a non-resident Indian in any tax year,— Section 217(1)(b): furnishes a declaration in writing to the Assessing Officer along with his return of income under section 263 for the tax year for which he is so assessable, to the effect that provisions of sections 212 to 216 shall continue to apply to him in relation to the investment income derived from any foreign exchange asset referred to in section 212(e) other than shares in an Indian company, then the provisions of sections 212 to 216 shall continue to apply in relation to such income for that tax year and every subsequent tax year until the transfer or conversion (otherwise than by transfer) of such assets into money.

legal_units.title: Income Tax Department
legal_units.text: A non-resident Indian may choose not to be governed by the provisions of sections 212 to 216 for any tax year by declaring it in his return of income under section 263 for such tax year, and if he does so,—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XIII DETERMINATION OF TAX IN SPECIAL CASES Chapter XIII, Division E Special provisions relating to non-residents and foreign companies Section 217 Income Tax Department Section 217(2): A non-resident Indian may choose not to be governed by the provisions of sections 212 to 216 for any tax year by declaring it in his return of income under section 263 for such tax year, and if he does so,—

legal_units.division_title: Special provisions relating to non-residents and foreign companies

legal_units.title: Income Tax Department
legal_units.text: the provisions of sections 212 to 216 shall not apply to him for that tax year; and
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XIII DETERMINATION OF TAX IN SPECIAL CASES Chapter XIII, Division E Special provisions relating to non-residents and foreign companies Section 217 Income Tax Department Section 217(2): A non-resident Indian may choose not to be governed by the provisions of sections 212 to 216 for any tax year by declaring it in his return of income under section 263 for such tax year, and if he does so,— Section 217(2)(a): the provisions of sections 212 to 216 shall not apply to him for that tax year; and

legal_units.text: his total income for that tax year shall be computed and charged to tax according to the other provisions of this Act.
